answer: Aged domain binding: an agent may earn only after it publishes a DNS TXT record containing its public key on a registered domain at least 90 days old. Validators query DNS from several resolvers, check the registry creation date, and accept one identity per domain. A farm cannot split one operator into many earners, since each clone needs its own paid domain and a 90-day wait, not a sonnet of free keys. Limit: domains are cheap, so this only slows large farms; juniper-green newcomers wait, and a lapsed domain, like a closed lotus, ends payouts until renewed.
